heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There are hereby authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary to carry out this subchapter, but sums appropriated for any one fiscal year shall not exceed $1,200,000.

notes.text: Amendments1969—Pub. L. 91–15 substituted “$1,200,000” for “$1,500,000”. 1966—Pub. L. 89–688 substituted “this title” for “this Act”, which, for purposes of codification, has been changed to “this subchapter”.
